title: Electrolysis
description: Consultation-led electrolysis appointments for hair removal, red veins and skin tags.
consultation: All new electrolysis hair removal clients must attend a consultation at least 24 hours before treatment. Choose a short consultation if you have had electrolysis elsewhere, or a full consultation if you are new to it.

offerings.name: Short consultation
offerings.description: For clients who have had electrolysis elsewhere; includes a history review and test patch.

offerings.name: Full consultation
offerings.description: For clients new to electrolysis; includes discussion of the area and a treatment plan.

faqs.question: Do I need a consultation first?
faqs.answer: Yes. New hair removal clients must have a consultation at least 24 hours before treatment, including those previously treated elsewhere.

faqs.question: How is my appointment plan decided?
faqs.answer: Your consultation covers your goals, treatment area and previous experience. Appointment frequency and length are discussed individually.

faqs.question: What support is provided afterwards?
faqs.answer: Solace provides aftercare guidance following the appointment.

title: Facials
description: Personalised facials using Vagheggi and DermaFix products, with options for different preferences and appointment lengths.

offerings.name: Calm & Restore Facial
offerings.description: A Vagheggi facial with enzyme exfoliation and a calming ampoule.

offerings.name: Balance & Clarify Facial
offerings.description: A Vagheggi facial with enzyme exfoliation, extractions where needed and high-frequency therapy.

offerings.name: Hydrating & Revitalising Facial
offerings.description: Includes exfoliation, a jelly mask, and extended neck, shoulder and facial massage.

offerings.name: Bespoke Sensory Facial
offerings.description: A personalised selection of exfoliation, masks, massage and serums.

offerings.name: C-Glow Skin Brightening
offerings.description: A DermaFix facial incorporating an enzyme exfoliant, peel, vitamin C and mask.

offerings.name: Firming Enzyme Facial
offerings.description: A DermaFix enzyme facial with a customised serum blend and facial massage.

offerings.name: Corrective Enzyme Facial
offerings.description: A DermaFix enzyme treatment with focused facial massage.

offerings.name: Teen Facial
offerings.description: Includes cleansing, exfoliation, extractions where appropriate and skincare education; facial massage is omitted.

faqs.question: Can a facial be personalised?
faqs.answer: The Bespoke Sensory Facial is tailored to your skin on the day, with 30-, 60- and 90-minute options.

faqs.question: Which skincare ranges are used?
faqs.answer: Solace lists Vagheggi Sensory Facials and DermaFix Cosmeceutical Facials.

title: Lashes & brows
description: Brow shaping and Brow Code tinting, with individual appointments and lash-and-brow combinations.
consultation: If you have never had tinting before, Solace strongly recommends a free patch test at least 24 hours before your treatment.

offerings.name: The Signature Trio
offerings.description: Lash tint, brow tint and tidy.

offerings.name: The Signature Sculpt Trio
offerings.description: Lash tint, brow sculpt and tint.

faqs.question: What is included in the Signature Trio?
faqs.answer: Lash tint, brow tint and a brow tidy. The Signature Sculpt Trio includes brow sculpting instead of a tidy.

faqs.question: Is a tinting patch test available?
faqs.answer: Yes. A free patch test at least 24 hours beforehand is strongly recommended for first-time tinting clients.

title: Body waxing
description: Lycon waxing for legs, underarms and intimate areas, with options for first-time and returning clients.

offerings.name: Brazilian — Over 8 Weeks
offerings.description: Also the option for a first-time Brazilian wax.

faqs.question: Which Brazilian appointment should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose the 45-minute Over 8 Weeks appointment for your first Brazilian or if it has been more than eight weeks. The Under 8 Weeks option is 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Which waxes are used?
faqs.answer: Solace lists Lycon Pinkini Hot Wax for intimate and sensitive areas and Lycon Active Gold Strip Wax for larger areas.

title: Facial waxing
description: Brow Code facial waxing for the lip, chin or full face.

offerings.name: Full Face
offerings.description: Includes a brow tidy.

faqs.question: Does full-face waxing include brows?
faqs.answer: The full-face appointment includes a brow tidy.

faqs.question: Which wax is used?
faqs.answer: Solace uses Brow Code wax for facial waxing.

title: Massage
description: The Solace Ritual and focused back, neck and shoulder massage, with pressure tailored to your preferences.

offerings.name: The Solace Ritual
offerings.description: Back, neck and shoulder work followed by facial and scalp massage.

offerings.name: Back, Neck & Shoulder — Relaxation Massage
offerings.description: A focused massage using slow strokes, with pressure tailored to you.

offerings.name: Back, Neck & Shoulder — Deep Tissue Massage
offerings.description: A focused option using firmer pressure.

faqs.question: What does the Solace Ritual include?
faqs.answer: It focuses on the back, neck and shoulders before moving to facial and scalp massage.

faqs.question: Can I discuss my preferred pressure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sessions are tailored to your preferences, comfort level and treatment goals.

faqs.question: Where can I find appointment lengths and prices?
faqs.answer: Check the online booking menu or contact Solace. The public massage page does not list these details.

title: Lymphatic drainage
description: A light-pressure massage using slow, rhythmic movements.

offerings.name: Lymphatic Drainage
offerings.description: A gentle massage using light sweeping, pulsing and repetitive movements.

faqs.question: Is this a deep-pressure massage?
faqs.answer: No. The treatment is described as light, slow and rhythmic rather than firm or deep.

faqs.question: Where can I find appointment lengths and prices?
faqs.answer: Check the online booking menu or contact Solace. The public lymphatic drainage page does not list these details.

title: Dermal needling
description: Dermal needling with DermaFix products and a personalised treatment approach.

offerings.name: Dermal Needling
offerings.description: Treatment includes a cleanse and customised serums. Facial needling sessions also include a hydrogel mask and LED light therapy.

faqs.question: What is included with facial needling?
faqs.answer: The source menu specifies a hydrogel mask and LED light therapy for facial needling sessions.

faqs.question: How is the treatment personalised?
faqs.answer: Product selection and needling depth are adjusted to the treatment plan.

faqs.question: Where can I find appointment lengths and prices?
faqs.answer: Check the online booking menu or contact Solace. The public dermal needling page does not list standalone prices or durations.

faqs.question: Is a course option listed?
faqs.answer: The dermal needling page offers a fourth session complimentary when three sessions are prepaid. Confirm your treatment selections and applicable details with Solace.

title: Alkaline treatments
description: DermaFix Conditioning Alkaline Wash appointments for selected hair-removal areas and heel care.
consultation: A consultation and patch test are required before alkaline treatment.

offerings.name: Heel Softening
offerings.description: An alkaline treatment for rough or callused heels.

faqs.question: Is a patch test required?
faqs.answer: Yes. Solace requires a patch test before treatment and a consultation to discuss suitability.

faqs.question: Are both hair and heel treatments offered?
faqs.answer: Yes. The menu lists hair-reduction areas and a separate heel-softening appointment.

title: Solace Journeys
description: Multi-appointment skin, massage and body-treatment packages, personalised as your appointments progress.

offerings.name: Future Proof
offerings.description: Bespoke Facial, Corrective Enzyme, C-Glow Facial and Firming Enzyme.

offerings.name: Reverse Time
offerings.description: Bespoke Facial, Corrective Enzyme, face-and-neck dermal needling, Firming Enzyme and C-Glow Facial.

offerings.name: Clarify
offerings.description: Bespoke Facial, Corrective Enzyme, Balance Facial with a peel, and Recovery/Integration Facial. High-frequency therapy as needed.

offerings.name: Soothe
offerings.description: Two Bespoke Facials, Calm & Restore Facial and Enzyme Facial with LED.

offerings.name: Illuminate
offerings.description: Bespoke Facial, two C-Glow Facials and Corrective Enzyme.

offerings.name: Detox
offerings.description: Five full-body lymphatic drainage sessions. Valid for 10 weeks from the first session.

offerings.name: Unwind
offerings.description: Three extended Solace Ritual appointments, each including foot massage.

offerings.name: Surrender — The Ultimate Escape
offerings.description: A four-visit package combining facials, body treatments and massage.

faqs.question: How do skin journeys begin?
faqs.answer: Each skin journey starts with a Bespoke Facial. Treatments can be adjusted as your skin responds.

faqs.question: Does the Detox journey have a time limit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its five sessions must be used within 10 weeks of the first session.

faqs.question: Can a journey be personalised?
faqs.answer: Solace describes its journeys as personalised and adjusted over the course of treatment.
